a Kademlia DHT with parallelism degree 3, replication degree 3 and a small KeepAlive interval (e.g., 30 seconds) is sufficient to achieve good performance in the face of churn, and that the mobile nodes can be full peers in the P2P overlay.

a parallel lookup mechanism with a lookup parallelism of 3 and replication degree of 2 is sufficient for achieving a high resource lookup ratio, and that mobile devices can act as full-fledged nodes in the overlay.

a parallel lookup degree of 3 is enough for guaranteeing high lookup success ratio in most situations; a resource replication degree of three is also enough for guaranteeing good lookup success ratio; a mobile node can be a fully-fledged peer; and, the WLAN access mode consumes slightly less power than the UMTS.
